adoration.text: Eucharistic Adoration and Sacred Heart devotion Fridays 17:30.

confession.text: Daily 45 minutes before Mass; Friday 11:00–13:00. Spanish Mass confession 30 minutes beforehand.

good_to_know.text: Lost items retained for one month then disposed; contact office promptly.

events.title: RCIA registration deadline
events.text: Wednesday journey 19:45–21:15 began 29 July. Contact office before registration closes.

getting_there.text: MRT City Hall(EW13/NS25), Bugis(DT14/EW12), Bras Basah(CC2). Website bus lists: Hotel Grand Pacific 2/7/12/32/33/51/61/63/80/175/NR7; St Joseph’s Church 130/133/145/197/851/960/NR7. These are parish-published routes, not independently verified.
Wedding guests: church parking limited and subject to availability; use nearby outside parking when full.

sacraments.text: 2026 journey began 29 July, Wednesdays 19:45–21:15. Registration closes 30 September 2026; download adult baptism form and contact Administration.
Infant baptism guidelines and application form downloadable; contact Administration for booking.
Office arranges priest visit at home or hospital. Pastoral Care Communion ministers support sick/homebound members with Communion and regular follow-up visits.

Book at least one year ahead. Saturday weddings 10:00/14:00, maximum two; weekdays negotiable. Provisional booking held three months without payment. Arrange celebrant, complete MPC/CEE (or discuss personalised preparation with priest) and Prenuptial Inquiry. Preparation appointments usually six months ahead after documents received. Book rehearsal in week before wedding in advance.
Contact office to arrange priest visit.
2026: Saturday 15:30–16:30 ages 13–16; Sunday 11:30–12:30 ages 7–12. Registration and catechist volunteer forms linked.

Saturday or weekday by Rector/church availability; submit complete application at least one week before intended baptism. Both parents/all godparents must attend Monday 19:00 preparation, Parochial House L2 or minister’s chosen venue. One or two confirmed practising Catholic godparents, ordinarily 16+, at most one of each gender. Supply child birth certificate, parents Catholic/civil marriage certificates, godparents baptism/confirmation certificates; non-English documents officially translated. Confirm dated instructions with office.

March 2021 guidelines: Catholic wakes only;07:30–22:30, no overnight staying, everyone leaves by 22:30. Submit form with death certificate and baptism extract to administrator. Funeral normally~1.5h before confirmed cremation/burial; office confirms priest/time. Office arranges Catholic night prayers and choir contact. Pre-cooked outside catering permitted; clear waste each night.

Saturday 10:00/14:00 only in PDF, unlike webpage allowing negotiable weekdays. Book at least one year ahead; arrange your own priest (Rector/assistant on availability), complete EE/MPC, pre-nuptial inquiry at least 6 months before. Submit full booking documents/payment within 3 months or reservation released. Rehearsal Tue/Wed/Thu 19:30–20:30 same week. PDF says unavailable 2 weeks before Christmas/3 before Holy Saturday; elsewhere says no December weddings. Confirm inconsistent restrictions.

other.text: Mass intention enquiries: sjc.myprayers@catholic.org.sg. Fax 6338 8554, not a second telephone line.
Booking guidelines available for church, Parlour of Repose, pastoral rooms/event hall.

Wedding PDF August 2025 published charges: main church$1,350; optional Father Francisco Maia Hall$650 plus$100 cleaning. Hall max 100 with buffet, for 10:00 weddings only, unavailable June/November; activities/carpark clear by 15:00. Non-refundable booking payment. Confirm charges with office before booking.
